description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to test part results in Google Test framework, including TestPartResult, TestPartResultArray, and internal helper classes for handling test failures.

classes.name: TestPartResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a test assertion or failure, including outcome, file, line, and message.

classes.name: TestPartResultReporterInterface
classes.description: Interface for reporting test part results.

classes.name: HasNewFatalFailureHelper
classes.description: Helper class to detect new fatal failures during test assertions.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Adds a TestPartResult to the array.

methods.name: GetTestPartResult
methods.description: Retrieves a specific TestPartResult by index.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of TestPartResults in the array.

methods.name: ReportTestPartResult
methods.description: Reports a test part result (interface method).

methods.name: has_new_fatal_failure
methods.description: Checks if a new fatal failure was detected.
